div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
公共临时客户生成正数记录与流水
处理操作调账-往来、账户类型挂帐
金额为订单总额减关联退款总额

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
已迁移订单详情在合作伙伴信息下增加变更记录
原伙伴、现伙伴、操作人、变更时间

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 整体回滚：不创建伙伴、不迁移订单、不生成流水

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
迁移订单不再参与公共临时客户回款
后续按目标伙伴普通账户规则处理

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 订单当前归属及回款状态

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
按订单保存的实际账户类型增加退款金额
生成退款正数流水，不受后续默认值变更影响

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
增加挂帐账户
生成退款流水并动态减少订单应回款金额

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
先生成退款正数流水
再生成同额负数已回款订单退款调账

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
资金流水按充值、消费、退款、其他收入、调账展示
调账-往来显示原处理操作并归入调账标签
按账户类型、时间、单据和快照追溯

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
按日默认当天 / 按月默认当月
必须选择合作伙伴，候选含启用、禁用、公共临时客户

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
按日期统计人数、消费、到款
范围内调账单列；合计行展示查询时当前预付款余额和挂帐金额
